title: Psalms 2
paragraphs: ¹ Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot in vain? ² The kings of the earth take their stand; the rulers conspire together against the LORD and against his anointed one, saying, ³ "Let's break their chains and throw off their restraints." ⁴ The one enthroned in heaven laughs; the LORD holds them in contempt. ⁵ Then he rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his fury.

⁶ "I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain." ⁷ I will proclaim the LORD's decree: he said to me, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father. ⁸ Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession. ⁹ You will break them with an iron scepter; you will shatter them like pottery." ¹⁰ So be wise, you kings; take this warning, you rulers of the earth.

¹¹ Serve the LORD with reverence, and celebrate with trembling. ¹² Pay homage to the Son, or he will be angry and you will perish in your way — for his wrath can flare up in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
